reports.title: Elvon Morton: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Documentation of key stages in Mr [name redacted] care was poor or non-existent. Critical decisions on; mental capacity, best interests, the choice of sedation, the amount of drug administered, the method of administration and the timing of administration were not clearly recorded.
The decision to sedate Mr Morton was flawed. The lack of contemporary documentation impeded an effective coronial investigation and review of that clinical decision.

A failure in governance at the Trust meant that this case was not identified as a serious incident. This omission gives rise to a concern that future deaths may follow due to an inability on the part of the trust to identify, reflect upon, and remediate sub-optimal practice
the trust's Datix incident reporting system, morbidity and mortality meeting process and SIRMAP procedure were inadequate. Each structure was siloed from the other, leading to inconsistent findings.

reports.title: Kenneth Foster: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths

concerns.quote: A failure in governance at the Trust meant that this case was not identified as an incident worthy of investigation through the Patient Safety Framework
In this case the trust's Datix incident reporting system, morbidity and mortality meeting process and PSIRF procedure were inadequate

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that the trust's Datix incident reporting system, morbidity and mortality meeting process, and its safety investigation procedure were inadequate and operated in silos, preventing proper identification and learning from sub‑optimal practice.
links.earlier_quote: In this case the trust's Datix incident reporting system, morbidity and mortality meeting process and SIRMAP procedure were inadequate. Each structure was siloed from the other, leading to inconsistent findings.
links.later_quote: In this case the trust's Datix incident reporting system, morbidity and mortality meeting process and PSIRF procedure were inadequate.
links.promise_quote: A specific induction programme has been formulated for the A&E which specifically covers themes such as the mental capacity act, contemporaneous documentation including emergency administered drugs with rationale, sedation and also escalation.
